newsitem.title: USA: Conrail says holders seen defeating vote.
newsitem.headline: Conrail says holders seen defeating vote.

text.p: Shareholders of Conrail Inc appear to have voted against a measure crucial to the railroad's planned $9.3 billion merger with CSX Inc, said Conrail chairman David LeVan.
A Norfolk Southern Corp spokesman also said the measure appeared defeated. He said his indications were based on vote results from Thursday night and Friday morning.
LeVan said Conrail will schedule a new shareholder vote. He did not specify a date.
"We will reschedule the meeting. We will move on. We have to get out and sell the value of this transaction," he said.

Asked what the company intended to do regarding the deal's structure, "We've made no decisions....We believe that the structure that exists today has value." However, he said "we will re-evaluate the transaction.".
